question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold.

The city has **immense **coal piers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"immense"** means extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example: **The immense popularity of the singer drew huge crowds to the concert.
 
 
 
• **"Huge"** refers to something that is extremely large in size, quantity, or degree. (विशाल)
 
 
• **Example: **The company made a huge profit last year.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'huge'** is a synonym for **'immense'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diminutive **(लघु): Extremely or unusually small.

 
 
• **Example:** The diminutive figure of the child was almost lost in the crowd.
 
 
 
• **Trifling **(तुच्छ): Of very little importance or value.
 
 
• **Example: **His trifling concerns were not worth discussing during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Set** (समूह): A group or collection of things that belong together or resemble one another.
 
 
• **Example:** She purchased a set of beautiful china dishes.
